states.do: State the goal in one sentence, who notices and how, checkable acceptance criteria, and out of scope. Ask the user only for product calls no experiment can settle.
states.exit: goal, who notices, acceptance criteria, out of scope

states.do: Read only the code you will touch: entry points, data shape, callers, nearest pattern. Then write the caller's usage, the types it implies, and what you will delete. Size L: compare two different designs.
states.exit: file:line refs, usage sketch, data shape, chosen design and why, deletions

states.do: Build the smallest diff that meets the criteria. To delegate, give a subagent `vstack brief` with SCOPE filled in and read its diff. Commit each unit that passes. If the design is wrong, run `vstack back design`.
Prove each acceptance criterion on the real surface: call the endpoint, run the CLI, open the page, read the value. Green tests prove only the tests.
states.exit: per criterion, what you ran and what you saw

states.do: Give `vstack brief --review` to a fresh reviewer that does not share your context (size L: two, on different models). Triage each finding: act on, consider, noted, dismissed. Fix act-on items, then `vstack back verify` if code changed. Details: {skill}/review.md
Make small ordered commits whose messages say why. PR text: what changed for whom, why this design, the evidence, risks. Push, open a PR, or merge only if the user authorized it.
states.exit: commit SHAs and PR link, or 'ready on branch <name>'
